title: Rabbi Acha son of Rabbi Yose
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He speaks in Rabbi Abba’s name: Shekalim, chapter 4, end of halakhah 1 — so Seder HaDorot cites. In the Babylonian-edition text Hyman uses, the reading is “Rabbi Yose in the name of Rabbi Acha in the name of Rabbi Ba,” and in the Jerusalem Talmud only “Rabbi Acha in the name of Rabbi Ba.”[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Shekalim passage has Acha reporting Ba. Hyman’s report of Yose reporting Acha reporting Ba in the Babylonian edition was not separately collated. “Babylonian edition” describes his edition report and does not turn Shekalim into a Babylonian-authored tractate. The heading’s filiation remains a source claim rather than a new genealogical finding.
